title: Zesty Ukrainian Dough Puff
description: A garlicky and crisp solo dinner dish featuring white flour and lamination puff, keto friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the melted butter, eggs, and water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Fold the dough in half lengthwise, then fold it in half again, rotating 90 degrees after each fold.
Roll out the dough again into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Cut the dough into 6 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with a little water and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.
Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
